## Interpretation

Prefer a writer whose surrounding window constructs or assigns the same large owner object that later appears as `r13`, not stack-local offsets like `[rsp+0x410]`. A true object-field writer usually has base register `rdi/rbx/r14/r15` and a non-stack source pointer.
